verdict.rationale: Termius is documented as a closed-source, cloud-synced SaaS client with a vault hosted on Termius' own servers (termius-docs-8, termius-docs-9), and community feedback explicitly flags discomfort with storing SSH keys/hostnames on Termius' third-party servers (termius-comm-4, termius-comm-10, termius-comm-16) with no mention of any self-hosted backend/server option. The 'local-only' mode (termius-docs-15) only means the client can cache credentials locally for offline connections, not that the core product/service can be self-hosted.
